nodes.text:
Commander Silas sits on the stone steps of the command dais with his lye-bleached helm beside him. In his scarred hands he holds the single unmelted strip of lead foil bearing his brother Tomas's name.

"I told the company that grief was a weakness the enemy would exploit," Silas says, his voice rough and human again. "So we burned our names into lead ingots, and when I couldn't bear the sight of Tomas's face in the fire, I drank the lye too. We turned ourselves into the very thing we were sent down here to destroy—hollow shells walking a circle in the dark."

He reaches into his belt-pouch and hands you a chalk-white phial of Alkali Clarity Draught, then gestures to the spoked bronze disc gleaming in the furnace grate. "Take the Seal of the Unclouded Sun, {player.name}. When the road back to Nocturne is clear, I will lead my men up to Sister Wren and Keeper Maeve—to learn if anything of who we were can still be salvaged."

choices.text: Sister Wren will welcome your men by the brazier, Commander.
I'll carry the Sun Seal to the crossroads.

nodes.text: Commander Silas traces the scratched letters of his brother's name on the lead strip. "Go on to the Gate of the Twin Seals, {player.name}. Our campaign in the dark is over."
